limitations.quote: // The final 0 of a match can start the next sequence.
limitations.note: The patch correctly holds `s3_d011` on invalid input, but also changes the post-match transitions to allow overlapping matches that the original and reference implementations do not report.
The test oracle checks every four-bit window of valid data and therefore expects overlaps, so exhaustive input coverage still could not catch the unintended change in post-match behavior.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted.
limitations.note: The rejected cleanup command forced the agent to resubmit the full simulation command, after an earlier Git check had already failed and skipped the chained simulator checks.
The agent found candidate transcripts with a filename-only search but did not inspect any matching passages before editing.
